prompt: Who is the most recent female middle school student to represent China in the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) contest?
answer: The most recent was **Yan Binwei (严彬玮)**. She represented China at the **2020 (61st) IMO**, earning a **silver medal**, while studying at **Nanjing Normal University Affiliated High School**. Here, “middle school student” is being used broadly to mean a secondary-school student; she was technically in high school.
